items.question: What is Twinlink Enterprise?
items.answer: Twinlink Enterprise is the Twinlink Platform deployed on your own systems by Twinlink's Forward Deployed Engineers. Expert computer-use agents automate processes across any software, including legacy systems, mainframes and desktop apps, without connectors, APIs or a rebuild of your infrastructure. Agents are deployed in weeks, and one Twinlink team is accountable for the model, the orchestration, the agents and the result.

items.question: How do Twinlink agents automate legacy systems that have no API?
items.answer: Twinlink agents use computer use: they read the screen and operate the interface the way a human operator would, clicking, typing and navigating applications. This is how they reach legacy systems, mainframes and internal tools that were never designed for automation. If an API exists, agents use standard integration patterns with no changes to your stack. In both cases they authenticate with standard Active Directory credentials and inherit exactly the read and write permissions you assign to that account. No admin rights.

items.question: What results do enterprises get with Twinlink agents?
items.answer: In production, Twinlink agents cut time-to-compliance by 50 to 70% on bank KYC onboarding, time-to-invoice by 90% on an energy company's order-to-cash process, and PO-to-invoice cycle time by 50% in procurement, where 80%+ of invoices are processed without manual intervention. None of these deployments required an integration.

items.question: How long does a Twinlink enterprise deployment take?
items.answer: Weeks. A Twinlink engagement follows five steps: discovery of the workflow and the systems it touches, a working prototype on your actual systems, a proposal with scope, timeline and success metrics agreed upfront, launch into production with Twinlink engineers embedded, then scale across processes, teams and geographies. You don't need an IT project or prior infrastructure, and Twinlink responds to demo requests within 24 hours.

items.question: Can Twinlink run on-premise or in a European sovereign cloud?
items.answer: Yes. Twinlink's default is multi-tenant, with dedicated encryption keys, dedicated API keys and strict logical isolation for each customer. For regulatory or data sovereignty requirements, Twinlink deploys on-premise or in a sovereign cloud: since November 2026 its agentic platform is available on the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, where customer content and customer-created metadata stay within the EU. Twinlink owns the entire inference chain, so your data never transits third-party models.

items.question: How does Twinlink protect enterprise data?
items.answer: Twinlink is SOC 2 Type I and Type II and ISO 27001 certified. Data is protected in four layers: encryption at rest and in transit, zero retention during inference, no training on your data, and tenant isolation with separate keys per customer. Screenshots are pre-processed and sensitive fields are redacted before any data leaves your perimeter, the connection is initiated only from your side, and every action is logged, timestamped and replayable for audit.

items.question: What are Twinlink's Forward Deployed Engineers?
items.answer: Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are Twinlink engineers who embed in your process and stay close to the work, from discovery to scale. They learn how your business runs day to day, so the agents understand it before they go live. They are included in Twinlink Enterprise, which makes one team accountable for both the software and the outcome.

items.question: How much does Twinlink Enterprise cost?
items.answer: Twinlink Enterprise is priced on custom terms: custom rates, dedicated support, and agents that run on your systems. Because Twinlink owns its models and inference, costs stay predictable, with no surprise bills and no exposure to third-party pricing changes. The first step is mapping one of your workflows and delivering a measurable outcome before you commit.
